notes.title: 🌿 Vexlands Expands. Couch Co-Op and Big Surprises Coming 2026!
notes.notes:
[previewyoutube="rQv-WEwbZMo;full"][/previewyoutube][p]🌿 [b]Vexlands is growing…[/b]

The world of Vexlands is a realm of surprises, with mysterious, shrouded hex-cells waiting to be cleansed. Unlock the land, gather resources, and uncover the story hidden within the ruins of a world struck by calamity. Some cells reward you with treasure and materials, while others hide dangers, dungeons, and creatures that will test your courage.

Crafting is at the heart of Vexlands. Build tools, structures, and defenses for your hero and village as you explore new biomes and return with loot. Raise animals, fish by quiet waters, decorate your home, or venture into dangerous caverns for puzzles and rare rewards. notes.title: 🌿 The Biggest Vexlands Demo Update Yet – Now Steam Deck Ready!
notes.notes:
[b][h3]📜 The Biggest Vexlands Demo Update Is Here![/h3][/b]

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44009071/cc01083cf0ee627caf440a03ee9d20da93349eef.gif][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44009071/cc01083cf0ee627caf440a03ee9d20da93349eef.gif[/img][/url]

Eager explorers, your journey through Vexlands just got bigger! This latest update is packed with new skills, dungeons, crafting mechanics, and more. Plus, we’re officially [b]Steam Deck Ready[/b] with full controller support!

As the last human survivor, venture deeper into the world, cleanse its lands, and uncover its secrets. With each area restored, unlock new resources, collectibles, and abilities to aid in your survival. But beware... Mysteries [i](and dangers)[/i] lurk in every corner!

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44009071/4f3655ab73262420f3b32b0dd6522d40c0ab790e.gif][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44009071/4f3655ab73262420f3b32b0dd6522d40c0ab790e.gif[/img][/url]

[h3]🔥 What’s New in This Update?[/h3]

[u][b]🛠 New Features & Mechanics[/b][/u]
	•	Skill System – Unlock powerful upgrades via the Skillboard & Rewardo
	•	World Map – Finally, a way to keep track of your expanding world!
	•	Underground Mines – Dig deep and gather rare minerals.
	•	Animal Taming – Rehome wild creatures like chickens for sustainable resources.
	•	Fishing & Fish Traps – A new way to gather food and relax by the water.
	•	Bug Collecting – Catch & display rare critters at the Collector’s House.
	•	Journal – Keep track of recipes, quests, blueprints, and a bestiary.
	•	Helper & Helper’s Hut – Automate gathering and storage with a trusty assistant!

[u][b]⚔️ Exploration & Combat Expansions[/b][/u]
	•	2nd Dungeon – Face new enemies and conquer hidden dangers.
	•	Shrinker – A mysterious new tool for spatial manipulation.
	•	World Event – Meteors! Survive and scavenge the aftermath for rare materials.

[u][b]💎 Crafting & Customization[/b][/u]
	•	Gem Merging & Ring Socketing – Boost your stats and unlock new effects.
	•	Glass Crafting – Dig sand, smelt glass, and create valuable new items.
	•	New Hairstyles, Hats & Body Types – Customize your character like never before!

[u][b]🎮 Now Fully Steam Deck Ready![/b][/u]
Enjoy full controller support and explore Vexlands with ease, whether on PC or Steam Deck!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44009071/918ef545ab02959b268ebfae35f32426b7f4542d.gif[/img]

This is just the beginning! Major updates are planned for 2025, including entirely new systems, areas, and surprises. Jump in now, share your feedback, and help us shape the world of Vexlands! Follow us on Twitter/X [url=https://x.com/VexlandsGame]@VexlandsGame[/url].  Join the [url=discord.gg/apogee]Apogee Discord[/url] to join in on the conversation!

[h3][b]Play the updated demo now on Steam![/b][/h3]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2184280/Vexlands/

notes.title: Unearth New Adventures: Vexlands Demo Update!
notes.notes:
[b]Welcome to the largest Vexlands demo update[/b], showcasing over a year of progress and setting the stage for even bigger things in 2025. This quiet QA test is your chance to explore what’s new, from updated biome generation to exciting features like skill rewards, new dungeons, and weather effects.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44009071/566ed926454966d458a830c6a35119192484e065.png[/img]

[b]Here’s a taste of what’s inside:[/b]
[list]
[*]Skill System: [i]Unlock rewards on the Skillboard with the help of Rewardo[/i].
[*]World Expansion: [i]Explore a second dungeon, underground mines, and new biome generation.[/i]
[*]Life Systems: [i]Fish, set traps, tame animals, and collect bugs in a new unlockable area.[/i]
[*]Customization: [i]Merge gems and socket rings and choose from new hairstyles, hats, and bodies.[/i]
[*]Crafting & Survival: [i]Sand digging, glass crafting, and the all-new Atomizer to move buildings.[/i]
[*]Journals & QoL: [i]Dive into the bestiary, quest log and enjoy streamlined inventory sorting, shop interfaces, and more. [/i]
[*]World Events: [i]Experience meteors, unlocking weather like rain, and other surprises![/i]
[/list]

[b]Note: [/b]This is a soft release of a LOT of new content, and we fully expect there to be issues still to tweak and polish, so we'll be reading all the comments & feedback and using it to improve the game.

This demo is just the beginning. With major updates planned in 2025, including entirely new systems and surprises, Vexlands is leveling up like never before. 

Follow us:
[list]
[*] [url=https://x.com/VexlandsGame]Vexlands [/url]and [url=https://x.com/Apogee_Ent]Apogee [/url]on Twitter/x!
[*] [url=https://discord.gg/FkHyPVnZX8]Discord[/url]
[/list]

[b]Start your adventure today and help shape the future of Vexlands![/b] ːCotcTorchː
